desc: Precompute all primes up to $10^6$ using a sieve.
Generate all numbers $S \le 10^6$ with exactly two distinct prime factors by iterating over prime pairs and exponents.
Compute $N = S^2$ for each valid $S$ and collect all $N \le 10^{12}$ into a sorted list.
Remove duplicates from the list of 400 numbers.
For each query, use binary search (bisect_right) to find the largest 400 number $\le A$.
